prompts.expressive: Four isolated full-body watercolor chibi Fae poses on pure green #00FF00 matching fae-model-sheet-v2: cheer, shock (clear warm-brown pupils inside wide surprised eyes), sit (with backpack and brown journal), talk_01 (with backpack and brown journal). No ground shadow, no text, no floating icons.
prompts.tools: Three isolated full-body watercolor chibi Fae tool poses on pure green #00FF00 matching fae-model-sheet-v2 and the approved blacklight lantern, rainbow lasso, and painted flute concepts: tool_lantern, tool_lasso, tool_flute. Each figure and held tool forms one clean connected silhouette.

postProcessing.extract: extract-figures.ts connected-component extraction (4 expressive poses, 3 tool poses)
postProcessing.key: #00FF00 border flood plus enclosed holes (--holes, 18% fuzz, edge despill only)
postProcessing.despill: despill-edge.ts green edge-only despill (band 12 pre-resize and post-resize)
postProcessing.atlas: 4 columns x 2 rows alpha-WebP companion atlas (public/assets/characters/fae/fae-poses.webp + .json)
postProcessing.review: art/review/e2-fae-poses-cream.jpg and art/review/e2-fae-poses-dark.jpg (with base down_idle_01 in slot 0)
